name: Scrap Warren
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
description: A large 5-foot-high pile of junk towers above the ground with holes in it big enough for only rats to squeeze through.
disable: DC 12 Thievery to stabilize the junk pile, DC 14 Survival to collapse it down on itself, or DC 16 Athletics to smash through it without setting it off

defensiveAbilities.name: Spiky Collapse
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature other than a scrap rat enters the area of the junk warren

Effect The warren collapses in on the creature, making a melee strike with an attack modifier of +5. If the trap was undetected, the creature is Off-Guard against this attack.

Critical Success The creature takes double damage and gains the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn (Escape dc=15).

Success The creature takes 1d6 Piercing Damage damage and gains the Grabbed condition until the end of its next turn (Escape dc=15).
